Welcome to CORE Chiropractic – Houston’s trusted choice for chiropractic care, proudly serving the Galleria, Greenway Plaza, and Memorial City areas.

We help Houstonians get out of pain and back to doing what they love—without drugs or surgery.

From chronic back and neck pain to sciatica, posture issues, and disc problems, our expert team uses digital x-rays, spinal decompression, PEMF therapy, and personalized adjustments to get real results.

🏆 Voted Best Chiropractor by the Houston Chronicle 5 years in a row (2022–2026)
🏆 Winner of Best Alternative Pain Management 3 years in a row (2024 - 2026)

Subscribe for tips, exercises, and real patient success stories from one of Houston’s top-rated chiropractic clinics.
